response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS fee_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_count, avg_net_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) FROM s) AS deviation_from_mean_of_averages FROM s
